description: This PHP class 'FormatWithEducation' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to format entity values by fetching and returning the name of an education record based on an ID, using the 'EducationService'. It is part of the 'OrangeHRM' system's maintenance access strategy, specifically for formatting values related to education data.

classes.name: FormatWithEducation
classes.description: A class that formats an entity value into the corresponding education name by retrieving education data from the 'EducationService'.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the education name corresponding to the given entity value (ID), or null if not found.

methods.name: getEducationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of 'EducationService'.
